newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Surgut oil firm president chairs large shareholder.
newsitem.headline: Surgut oil firm president chairs large shareholder.

text.p: Pension-fund manager ZAO Surgutfondinvest, which last month won an investment tender for 40.12 percent of Surgut Holding, one of Russia's top three oil companies, now shares its top executive posts with the oil company, the NAUFOR brokers association said on Wednesday.

Vladimir Bogdanov, the president of Surgut Holding (NK Surgutneftegaz), and chief executive of its main operating company AO Surgutneftegaz, is chairman of the four-member board of directors of Surgutfondinvest, NAUFOR said in a statement to Reuters.
Another member of the board, Natalya Olshanova, is vice-president of Surgut Holding.
Surgutfondinvest has only three employees. It was not clear whether these included chief executive Oleg Yeremenko, who is a member of the board.
It shares a telephone number with Surgut's pension fund, which had controlled the stake under the government's shares for loans scheme, until last month's tender.
Surgut Holding owns a majority of the pension fund.
Surgutfondinvest became a member of NAUFOR last year.
